## Hypothesis

H1: We predict religious affiliation (Religion_type) (categorical IV) will predict time spent living in country of birth (Country_live_time) (continuous DV).

H2: We predict casual sexual experiences and preferences (composite continuous IV; mean of soi_behave, soi_attitude, and soi_desire) will predict relationship duration (Relationship_length) (continuous DV).

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)
```

```{r Load data}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h1.csv")

h2Data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h2.csv")


#reorganize categorical variable
table(h1Data$Religion_type)
h1Data$Religion_type <- factor(h1Data$Religion_type, 
                           levels = c("Christianity", "Islam", "Hinduism", "Buddhism", "Other", "Judaism", "None"))
table(h1Data$Religion_type)
```

## H1 - Box Plot
```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.
h1Box <- ggplot(data = h1Data,
                aes(x = Religion_type, y = Country_live_time, fill = Religion_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "Religious affiliation", y = "Year(s) spent living in country of birth",
                        title = "Time spent living in country of birth by religious affiliation", fill = "Religious affiliation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

h1Box
```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)
```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
h1Viol <- ggplot(data = h1Data,
                aes(x = Religion_type, y = Country_live_time, fill = Religion_type)) +
                labs(x = "Religious affiliation", y = "Year(s) spent living in country of birth",
                        title = "Time spent living in country of birth by religious affiliation", fill = "Religion type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = .12)

h1Viol
```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot
```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.
h1Rain <- ggplot(data = h1Data,
                aes(x = Religion_type, y = Country_live_time, fill = Religion_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "Religious affiliation", y = "Year(s) spent living in country of birth",
                        title = "religious affiliation and how many years spent living in country of birth ", fill = "Religion_type") +
  geom_rain(alpha = .5) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) 
  
h1Rain
  #re-check what alpha is
```



```{r}
#Scatter Plot
h2point <- ggplot(data = h2Data, 
                  aes(x = soiComposite, y = Relationship_length)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Sociosexuality composite score", y = "Relationship duration", title = "Relationship between sociosexuality and relationship duration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

h2point

#Plot looks weird... why?
#total points
nrow(h2Data)
#what we're seeing since the data is stacking
nrow(unique(h2Data[, c("soiComposite", "Relationship_length")]))

#Jitter
h2jitter <- ggplot(data = h2Data, 
                  aes(x = soiComposite, y = Relationship_length)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.04, alpha = 0.04, size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Sociosexuality composite score", y = "Relationship duration", title = "Relationship between sociosexuality and relationship duration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

h2jitter
```

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2jitter + geom_smooth(method = "lm")

h2Line
```
